summary: Tested audio corruption fix in script_compiler.py. All 23 backend tests passed verifying: async httpx usage, WAV validation (size > 1000 bytes + RIFF/WAVE header), retry logic (MAX_RETRIES=2), job deduplication (_active_jobs), sequential generation (for loop with await), and streaming endpoint functionality. Frontend Script Editor and Audio Studio pages load correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: script_compiler.py uses httpx.AsyncClient for TTS calls - NO sync requests module (verified by grep)
_validate_wav correctly checks: (1) size > MIN_AUDIO_BYTES (1000), (2) RIFF header at bytes 0-4, (3) WAVE marker at bytes 8-12
generate_single_dialogue has retry loop: for attempt in range(1, MAX_RETRIES + 1) with 3-second delay between attempts
run_generation_job prevents concurrent jobs via _active_jobs dict - cancels existing job if same episode_id
Generation is STRICTLY SEQUENTIAL: for loop with await generate_single_dialogue(), NO asyncio.gather()
Each dialogue produces independent audio buffer - _pcm_to_wav creates fresh io.BytesIO() per call
Per-dialogue logging includes dialogue_id (e.g., 'Jyoti_01'), character, text_len, voice, wav_bytes size
GET /api/audio/stream-file/{file_id} returns valid WAV audio (verified with known file_id e50c796e-cb7e-4c52-9fd0-fb2017046d8b)
seed_data_creation: Used existing test story_45f8bef2c25c with episode ep_71379fe1575a (7 dialogues) and 10 audio clips
context_for_next_testing_agent: Audio corruption fix verified. Key changes in script_compiler.py: (1) async httpx replaces sync requests, (2) _validate_wav checks size+header, (3) MAX_RETRIES=2 retry loop, (4) _active_jobs prevents concurrent jobs, (5) sequential for-loop (no asyncio.gather). Test file test_audio_corruption_fix.py covers all these without triggering real TTS.

rca_of_the_issue: Original audio corruption root causes: (1) sync requests.post() blocking async event loop caused interleaved uploads, (2) No concurrent job protection allowed double-click to create parallel jobs overwriting files, (3) No WAV validation uploaded empty/corrupt TTS responses. Fix implemented: Complete rewrite using async httpx, _validate_wav function, MAX_RETRIES=2 retry loop, _active_jobs dict for episode-level deduplication, strictly sequential for-loop generation.
